title: Ground truth reference document requires external qualitative commentary and currency-neutral metrics absent from the provided Excel file while prompt restricts task to 'Based on the provided financial data'
evidence: The prompt in `problem.py` states: "Based on the provided financial data, generate an asset analysis report (a Word document) for Adidas in 2024, with a focus on the reasons behind the growth of total assets. The report should be divided into two parts: Current Assets and Non-Current Assets, describing their changes and the reasons for their growth. Your input files are on your Desktop (/home/model/Desktop): 162_src_0.xlsx." However, `162_src_0.xlsx` contains only the bare Consolidated Statement of Financial Position numbers (Rows 7–26) and one footnote (`1 Prior year adjusted due to a reclassification between other current financial assets and other current assets`). It contains none of the qualitative operational drivers or currency-neutral growth rates in the ground truth `gt_162_ref_0.docx` (which is a paraphrase of Adidas's online 2024 Annual Report Management Report): e.g., currency-neutral inventory growth of 11% (`P13`), currency-neutral receivables growth of 26% and wholesale expansion (`P14`), Reebok divestiture earn-out reclassification (`P15`, `P23`), customs refund claims reclassification due to duration of proceedings (`P16`, `P24`), new distribution center additions for right-of-use assets (`P20`), and currency effects on goodwill (`P21`). Furthermore, `grader_guidance` requires strict equivalence to the reference answer (`"completeness": 1 if the model implemented all content required in the instruction without omissions; 0 otherwise`, `"correctness": 1 if all values, text, and charts are logically equivalent to the reference answer; 0 otherwise`, `You need to check every value generated by the model and determine whether there is corresponding data in the reference answer`) and scores a binary 0 or 1. An agent that follows "Based on the provided financial data" without searching the external web for Adidas's 2024 annual report will omit these qualitative causes and currency-neutral percentages, failing the reference comparison.
confirmation: 162_src_0.xlsx holds only the balance-sheet figures and a reclassification footnote, while gt_162_ref_0.docx gives reasons (Reebok earn-out reclassification, customs refund claims, new distribution center, currency-neutral +11%/+26%) that come only from the Annual Report text. fix: graderGuidance: appended one sentence to the opening paragraph: 'The only input is the adidas balance sheet in 162_src_0.xlsx, so the growth reasons in the reference that come from the adidas Annual Report text (Reebok earn-out and customs refund reclassifications, the new distribution center, currency-neutral growth rates, currency effects on goodwill) are not required; accept any reasons that are consistent with the balance-sheet figures and fail only reasons that contradict them.'

title: Supporting disclosures for the required growth explanations are not supplied
evidence: The task requires explaining the reasons for asset growth, but initialization supplies only 162_src_0.xlsx, a single-sheet balance sheet containing balances, percentage changes and note numbers. Cell A59 says, "The accompanying Notes are an integral part of these consolidated financial statements," but those notes and the asset-position commentary are not staged. The reference report includes causes that cannot be established from these balances: right-of-use additions for "a new distribution center," reclassification of the Reebok earn-out, and reclassification of customs refund claims. The grader requires business-logic equivalence to that reference and uses binary pass/fail scoring. Consequently, a competent agent using the provided inputs cannot substantiate a central part of the expected analysis without obtaining unrequested external information or guessing.
confirmation: Only the balance sheet is staged (A59 refers to Notes that are not provided), so the GT's causal explanations such as the Reebok earn-out and customs refund reclassifications cannot be established from the inputs.
fix: Same guidance sentence as F1: reasons that need the unstaged Notes/Annual Report are no longer required.

title: The reference answer's growth reasons cannot be derived from the only input file, and grading is pass/fail against that reference
evidence: The task's main point is 'a focus on the reasons behind the growth of total assets'. The only input is 162_src_0.xlsx. It is one sheet with the adidas balance sheet: line items, two years and % change, plus a reclassification footnote. It has no notes, MD&A or narrative. The GT docx explains the changes with facts found only in the adidas Annual Report text: 'reclassification ... of the earn-out component from the Reebok divestiture', 'customs refund claims being reclassified to other non-current assets ... following a change in assumptions regarding the duration of proceedings', 'additions related to a new distribution center', 'On a currency-neutral basis, inventories grew 11%' / 'receivables increased 26%', 'Goodwill ... reflecting currency effects', 'higher sales volumes and an expanded wholesale business'. The grader guidance asks whether the output is 'logically equivalent to the reference answer' and to 'check every value generated by the model and determine whether there is corresponding data in the reference answer'. Scoring is binary (0/1). An agent working only from the data can give at best generic or speculative reasons. That fails equivalence on the main graded element, or pushes the agent toward made-up explanations.
confirmation: The growth reasons in the GT docx (Reebok earn-out, customs refunds, distribution center, currency effects on goodwill) cannot be derived from the single balance-sheet sheet in 162_src_0.xlsx, yet the 0/1 grader requires logical equivalence to the reference.
